title: Vector Resultants
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: VECTOR RESULTANTS
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical audio variants/repeated saves; runtime untested
versions.startupSource:
5 REMARK VECTOR RESULTANTS
6 REM          PLACE MAG,ANG IN DATA.   LINE 1000 END PROGRAM
10 READ MAGNITUDE
12 IF MAGNITUDE=0 THEN 100
14 READ ANGLE
20 ANGLE=ANGLE/180*3.14159
30 X=X+COS(ANGLE)*MAGNITUDE
40 Y=Y+SIN(ANGLE)*MAGNITUDE
50 GOTO 10
100 MAGNITUDE = SQR( X[2 + Y[2 )
110 ANGLE = ATN ( Y / X )
120 PRINT"TOTAL X=";X

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
